properties.description: One-off admin script: creates the Checkmark schema, a pass-through view over the physical checkmark_case_data table, and grants the Checkmark managed identity read access. Run manually against odw_curated_db (Built-in / serverless SQL pool) — not part of the daily pipeline.

content.query:
/*
THEODW: Grant Checkmark managed identity (pins-id-checkmark-odw-dev-uks) read access
to the physical curated table odw_curated_db.checkmark_case_data.

Pre-requisites (per investigation on the ticket):
- The managed identity pins-id-checkmark-odw-dev-uks already exists as a login/EXTERNAL_USER
  with CONNECT permission only (see workspace/sqlscript/add_user.json for the create-login/
  create-user steps if this ever needs recreating).
- odw_curated_db.checkmark_case_data is created/refreshed daily by the
  'checkmark_case_data' notebook in pln_curated.

This script only needs to be run once (or whenever the identity is recreated).
*/

-- 1. Dedicated schema for Checkmark data
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT  *
                FROM    sys.schemas
                WHERE   name = 'Checkmark' )
    EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA [Checkmark]');
GO


-- 2. Thin pass-through view exposing the physical table under the Checkmark schema.
--    No Spark-only functions are used here, since all transformation logic
--    (union, dedup, JSON aggregation, costsAppliedFor derivation) already
--    happened when the physical table was written by Spark.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW Checkmark.vw_checkmark_case_data
AS
SELECT
    caseReference,
    caseType,
    caseProcedure,
    caseOfficerId,
    allocationLevel,
    caseSpecialisms,
    linkedCaseStatus,
    isGreenBelt,
    costsAppliedFor,
    targetDate,
    inspectorId,
    inspectorFirstName,
    inspectorLastName,
    caseOfficerFirstName,
    caseOfficerLastName,
    event
FROM [odw_curated_db].[dbo].[checkmark_case_data];
GO


-- 3. Grant read access, scoped to the Checkmark schema only (least privilege —
--    the managed identity cannot see any other schema/table in odw_curated_db)
GRANT SELECT ON SCHEMA::Checkmark TO [pins-id-checkmark-odw-dev-uks];
GO


-- 4. Validation — run these as a sanity check after granting
-- Confirm the user exists and its permissions
SELECT
    DP.name,
    DP.type_desc,
    DP.authentication_type_desc
FROM sys.database_principals DP
WHERE DP.name = 'pins-id-checkmark-odw-dev-uks';

-- Confirm the grant is in place
SELECT
    perm.permission_name,
    perm.state_desc,
    princ.name AS grantee
FROM sys.database_permissions perm
JOIN sys.database_principals princ
    ON perm.grantee_principal_id = princ.principal_id
WHERE princ.name = 'pins-id-checkmark-odw-dev-uks';

-- Confirm the underlying physical table and view are visible
SELECT TOP 5 * FROM Checkmark.vw_checkmark_case_data;
